QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_20

question.text: The maximum single-investee concentration limit for a Category III AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.5: SEBI restricts Cat III AIF exposure to a single investee company to 10% of AUM or investable funds, directly or through units of other AIFs. The Trap: Option B is too strict. Option C is the Cat I/II limit (25%). Option D would defeat diversification. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B tests the Cat III 10% cap; XIX-A tests the Cat I/II 25% cap. Manager's Pro-Tip: Monitor this limit intraday during volatile markets — a single-day rally in a concentrated holding can breach the cap passively. SEBI has no 'passive breach' tolerance; curing within the next rebalance window is expected.
